objective:
Make the bundlebees verify writer emit provenance on every slice record.

BRIEF STATE: authored, not dispatchable. It embeds a DRAFT contract; the owner freezes (adds review.status=approved, approved_by, approved_at and contract_sha256) before dispatch, and the frozen body must stay byte-identical so the hash below does not move.

THE JOB. A verify record is the merge lane's only proof that a change was tested, and the lane binds it to the frozen base lease: repo, slice and contract_sha256 in the record must equal that lease's, or the record is refused even at a blob-equal head. Records written before this slice carry none of that and are not evidence. Implement:
- bundlebees_plugin/verify_provenance.py: repo_slug/slice_name/pull_number/contract_digest validators, pr_from_url/pr_from_delivery, from_lease (repo/slice/contract from the lease's embedded frozen acdd/1 contract, check_frozen recomputed), with_pr, stamp. Every refusal is ProvenanceError with code verify_provenance_missing (a binding field is absent) or verify_provenance_invalid (lease names something unusable). The pull request is stamped when known; an absent one leaves the binding intact so tdd/refactor verifies still record.
- bundlebees_plugin/cli.py: _write_verify_result gains provenance= and require_provenance=; a slice record is stamped and the 64-hex contract digest is restored after scrub(). _cmd_verify resolves the repo/slice/contract binding before any test runs, opens the PR before writing the record, resolves the PR from --pull-request, the delivery record, else the lease brief, and refuses verify_provenance_missing when the binding cannot be established. Legacy (uncontracted) records keep the historical shape.

Do not edit tests/test_verify_writer_provenance.py; it is the approved specification. Keep the final message under ~30 lines; put detail in the commit message.

criteria: AC-001 stamp attaches all four provenance fields, normalised, to a verify payload
AC-002 stamp refuses provenance missing repo, slice or contract_sha256, naming the field
AC-003 an unknown pull request is omitted, and a present but invalid one is refused
AC-004 each field is validated: repo slug, slice id, positive PR number and 64-hex digest
AC-005 provenance is bound to the lease's frozen contract and refuses a missing, edited or contradicting one
AC-006 the writer stamps the record, writes a PR-less binding, and refuses a slice record without its binding
AC-007 the CLI resolves the pull request from --pull-request, the delivery record, else the lease brief, and the repo from the brief else the origin slug
AC-008 an uncontracted attempt's record keeps the historical shape and carries no provenance fields

label: verify-writer

contract.title: Verify records carry repo, slice, PR and contract provenance, or are not written

outcome.summary: The verify writer stamps every record it writes for a contracted (slice) attempt with the repository slug, slice id and canonical contract hash that the record proves, plus the pull request number whenever one is known, and refuses to write a slice record it cannot bind. The merge lane already binds a record's repo/slice/contract_sha256 to the frozen base lease that classified the pull request, so a pre-provenance record is not evidence for any pull request; this slice makes the writer produce records the lane can accept, and makes an unbindable slice record a named refusal instead of a plausible-looking one.
observable_behavior: a verify record written for a contracted attempt carries repo (owner/name), slice (the contract id) and contract_sha256 (lower-case 64-hex) at top level, and pr (positive integer) whenever a pull request is known
the record is written after the verified branch's pull request is opened or found, so pr names the pull request the verified head belongs to when one exists

a contracted attempt whose repo, slice or contract cannot be established is refused before any test runs, with code verify_provenance_missing naming the field; a lease contract edited after freeze or a brief slice that disagrees with the contract id is refused verify_provenance_invalid

a pull request that is present in the provenance but not a positive integer is refused rather than dropped, while an absent one leaves the binding intact -- so tdd/refactor verifies that run before a PR exists still record valid exact-head evidence
an uncontracted (legacy) attempt keeps the historical record shape and never carries provenance, so the lane never mistakes it for slice evidence
verify --pull-request N names the pull request explicitly when it is not discoverable from the attempt's delivery record or the lease brief

dependencies: the merge lane reads verify-results/*.json and requires repo/slice/contract_sha256 to equal the frozen base lease (policy/merge-lane-v5.md)
assumptions: freezing this contract needs the owner's typed approval; it is authored as a draft and its PR carries it for that review
the lane's predicate binds on repo, slice and contract_sha256 and treats pr as additional evidence when present, so a verify that runs before a PR exists still records valid exact-head evidence
the pull request a first verify run opens is known before the record is written, because verify opens it eagerly and falls back to the delivery record

authorized: write the provenance module and the cli.py writer plumbing
run the approved test file in the sandbox
push the feature branch and open a pull request
not_authorized: change the gate, the lease store or the contract store beyond this PR's own files

reasons: verify code defines what 'verified' means for every slice the merge lane accepts
a wrongly accepted record could merge an unverified change
risk.blast_radius: every slice pull request the merge lane evaluates

risk: high: verify code; defines what 'verified' means for every slice
